segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func scaleToFit(_ entity: Entity, proxy: GeometryProxy3D, content: RealityViewContent) { guard let videoPlayer = videoEntity.videoPlayerComponent, videoPlayer.needsScaling else { return } let frame = proxy.frame(in: .local) let frameSize = abs(content.convert(frame.size, from: .local, to: .scene)) entity.scaleToFit(videoPlayer.playerScreenSize, within: frameSize) } ```
